exposure: high vs. low morphine milligram equivalents (MME)
cohort: Patients undergoing cesarean delivery, hysterectomy, spine surgery, total hip arthroplasty, or total knee arthroplasty in an academic healthcare system between January 2015 and June 2018
finding: Greater peri-surgical opioid exposure was statistically and clinically significantly associated with an increase in post-discharge adverse opioid-related outcomes, including persistent opioid use, opioid-related symptoms, and healthcare resource utilization.
